title: CircleCI: rerun a failed workflow (synthetic)
support_note: The circleci pack's classifier allows only a project-scoped `run list` (internal/circleciclassify/classifier.go) and refuses every other verb, so yolo cannot file this request. The object below is hand-written in the shape `yolo approve --json` uses, to show what a future write would ask.
story: An agent sees a flaky test fail the main workflow of example-org/app and asks to rerun only the failed jobs of that workflow.
